headline.caveat: 20-year lease for 191MW at Riot's Rockdale, TX campus through June 2048; two 5-year extension options lift potential value to $16.1B. Tenant identity is press-reported (Bloomberg) — Riot named only 'one of the world's leading frontier AI labs'. Confidence: low on counterparty, high on lease terms.

realized_to_date.caveat: Announced Aug 11, 2026; capacity delivery is staged — 96MW by Dec 2027, full 191MW by June 2028 — so no rent has flowed.

nature_md: A 20-year, ~$9.1B lease of 191MW of AI data-center capacity at Riot Platforms' Rockdale, Texas campus (through June 2048; $16.1B potential with two 5-year extensions), announced Aug 11, 2026. Riot disclosed the tenant only as a leading frontier AI lab; Bloomberg identified it as Anthropic, and this record follows that attribution at LOW confidence. Riot's second AI tenant after AMD (Jan 2026), bringing its contracted book to ~241MW / ~$9.8B. Riot arranged $573M of Morgan Stanley interim financing for early construction; capacity phases in from Dec 2027 to June 2028.

accounting.payer_treatment_md: If Anthropic is the tenant, it would capitalize the lease (ROU asset/liability) once capacity delivers from Dec 2027 — a direct-tenancy departure from its cloud-committed compute (AWS/Google) and Fluidstack-intermediated capacity. Nothing booked yet; Anthropic has not confirmed the deal.
accounting.payee_treatment_md: Riot books no revenue until first delivery (Dec 2027); the contracted stream backs its interim construction financing, with lease revenue recognized over the term thereafter.

both_sides_md: **Bull:** if confirmed, Anthropic going direct-to-miner shows labs disintermediating hyperscalers for capacity — and Riot re-rated ~17% in a day on the news. **Bear:** the counterparty is unconfirmed by either party; a 20-year obligation against a lab whose revenue is scaling but unprofitable is exactly the commitment-vs-capacity risk the tracker exists to flag.

events.title: Riot announces $9.1B, 191MW Rockdale lease; Bloomberg reports tenant is Anthropic

sources.notes: Source of the Anthropic identification; single-origin — treat counterparty as low confidence.
